audit_adjustments.initial_probe: The first ad hoc source-union reconstruction omitted p03 source_snapshot .inc additions and stopped on an assertion before writing a result. The corrected reconstruction explicitly includes those additions and all pinned dependency header roots. No production change was required.

limitations: This review hashes immutable Git blobs and inspects trusted build validators; it does not establish that a new binary was compiled or loaded.
The live-import closure was captured before the qualified reader import, without rerunning historical prerequisites; w03_a06 separately verifies no late imports through real historical replays.
The source inventory is a prospective clean-source union, not an observed fresh execution manifest; fetched dependency header paths are derived from locked Git trees.
Retained source paths are broader than compiled translation units. Diagnostic identities are inert proof/original data; source retention is not compilation.
System headers, compiler support inputs and malicious concurrent writers remain outside complete provenance.
